system-implementation.description: The system consists of a Docker image scanned using Docker Scout before deployment.

implemented-requirements.description: Docker Scout is used to perform automated vulnerability scans of Docker container images. The scanner identifies known CVEs affecting software packages contained within the image. Scan reports are retained as evidence. This implementation is limited to container image analysis and does not include authenticated scanning of running enterprise assets.
